acceptance.assertion: Terminal failures are classified into stable bounded reason classes with explicit retryability and owner-decision semantics.
Only retry-safe cases with authoritative terminal and lease evidence may be resumed automatically; ambiguous outcomes remain fail-closed.
Duplicate, superseded and already-satisfied attention records converge idempotently without deleting historical evidence.
Obligations close only when exact task, outcome receipt and current lifecycle truth agree.
Adversarial tests cover stale processes, unknown outcomes, retry exhaustion, duplicate obligations, evidence drift and idempotent replay.

approval.note: Implement bounded convergence logic without silently closing unresolved operator decisions or weakening task evidence.

goal: Introduce a deterministic convergence layer that classifies terminal task outcomes, retries only verified retry-safe failures, supersedes duplicate or obsolete attention records, and closes obligations only from authoritative evidence.

metadata.reason: Capability growth is currently limited by incomplete recovery and attention convergence rather than missing read surfaces.

title: Converge terminal tasks and operator attention
